subject: Block Coding (Concurrent Events)
arc_note: Grade 2 · Ontario Math C3 (Coding), the NEW concept is CONCURRENT — two sprites run their own scripts AT THE SAME TIME, both launched by one green flag ▶. Loops/variables still OUT (preview only); ≤8 total blocks across the two scripts. Lane = TWO number-path sprites — Bit (green ●, mascot bit_wave) and Pixel (purple ▲, mascot pixel_wave) — each with its own short block script (green-flag start at N + forward/back motion blocks) on a shared 0–5 number path; both run together and the questions are about the COMBINED outcome (both landing numbers, who is ahead, do they MEET on the same number). That combined/parallel reasoning is what makes the concurrency GENUINE (not two sequential tasks) — the C2 hard gate. Reuses the proven clamped 0–5 interpreter; solution.py runs BOTH scripts and asserts both landings + the combined answer. Arc: meet the two sprites → read both scripts → who is ahead → do they meet → BUILD Pixel's script (write concurrent, C3.1) → predict BOTH then run (C4-L4 'predict what happens when both start') → change one script & describe the effect on the pair (C3.2 interaction) → debug which of two parallel scripts is wrong (challenge). Two mascots distinguish the two sprites (C4-L3); each sheet has the predict-both prompt; the TG answer key explains the timing/interaction of the parallel scripts (C2-L4) and the common error of mistaking sequential for concurrent. Scaffold introduces Pixel's 2nd script only after Bit's is understood (C3-L4). Cite Grade-2 C3.1 + C3.2 verbatim ('sequential and concurrent events').

topics.title: Two Sprites at Once

topics.concept: run both scripts and find both landing numbers

topics.title: Who Is Ahead?
topics.concept: run both, compare the landings — which sprite is on the higher number

topics.title: Do They Meet?
topics.concept: run both — do the sprites land on the SAME number (meet) or not

topics.title: Build Pixel's Script

topics.title: Predict Both
topics.concept: predict where BOTH sprites land when the green flag starts them, then run
